description: gen schema lays out each sibling `use super::{...}` import exactly as rustfmt does at the 100-column boundary: the root document declares enums whose names make the imported documents' imports 100 columns wide as one line, as one wrapped row, and as the last of two wrapped rows after a 95-column row; the 100-column line wraps into one row; a single wrapped row of exactly 100 columns stays whole, because rustfmt does not charge the trailing comma of a list that fits one row; the last of two wrapped rows breaks again at the 99-column row limit. The three generated modules are pinned byte for byte against goldens that rustfmt leaves unchanged
